title: VASP coarse-mesh relaxation and final-mesh static calculation
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-relax-static-coarse workflow: it relaxes the geometry on a coarse k-point mesh, then evaluates the relaxed structure with a final-mesh static calculation, correcting the coarse relaxation once by the measured coarse-to-final offset when that static misses the force and stress limits.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure to relax.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the geometry of the final-mesh static, and output role total_energy is a records entry containing the total energy of the relaxed structure from the final-mesh static calculation.

outputs.name: relaxed_structure
outputs.description: The geometry of the final-mesh static: where the coarse-mesh relaxation ended, given only when that static is within the force and stress limits.

outputs.name: total_energy
outputs.description: The total energy of the relaxed structure from the final-mesh static calculation, given only when that static is within the force and stress limits.
